advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm whether `distinct_ratio_window` should be added to `_SHAPE_FIELDS` so it survives the durable write, or that persistence is intentionally deferred to the aec1 ticket (and correct the commit-message claim that the recorder already consumes it).
evidence: src/rebar/llm/usage_log.py:466: `for field in _SHAPE_FIELDS:` — record() persists ONLY allowlisted shape fields
src/rebar/llm/usage_log.py:245: `return {field: shape[field] for field in _SHAPE_FIELDS if field in shape}` — shape_only() filters identically
src/rebar/llm/usage_log.py:44-46: comment: 'Before bug aec1 all seven were computed and then DISCARDED at the write ... the one signal separating a LOOP from BREADTH never reached the record.'
Commit message: 'consumers (the c827 actuator, the aec1 recorder) share' the trip line — but the field is unreachable from a durable row.
advisory.finding: `distinct_ratio_window` is added to `_repetition_summary` but not to `_SHAPE_FIELDS`, so `record()` and `shape_only()` drop it at the durable-write boundary — the new signal never reaches the JSONL row, exactly the 'computed then discarded' defect the aec1 fix (documented at usage_log.py:44-46) exists to prevent. The commit message and ticket contract name 'the aec1 recorder' as a consumer, but a recorder reads the durable row, which will never carry this field.
scenarios: A gate run loops over a 4-cycle; the live log line shows distinct_ratio_window=0.167 but the persisted .rebar/usage.jsonl row omits it, so any later recorder/actuator reading the row cannot trip on it.

coaching.coaching: File a follow-on ticket (discovered_from this change) for missing _SHAPE_FIELDS registration for distinct_ratio_window, a pre-existing / out-of-scope issue — do not fix it in this change.
coaching.subject: missing _SHAPE_FIELDS registration for distinct_ratio_window
